verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly documents rollback to a previous deployed Worker version via Wrangler or dashboard (cloudflare-docs-23) and Wrangler commands for managing deployments (cloudflare-docs-11/20), plus first-class Git/GitHub Actions integration for standard version control (cloudflare-docs-17). This covers versioning and rollback for Worker-based automations but no explicit review/staging feature (e.g., diffing, approval gates, audit trail specific to automations) is documented. Missing for 10: dedicated review/approval workflow for automations, evidence tying rollback specifically to Workflows/Agents rather than generic Worker deployments, independent hands-on confirmation of the rollback feature.
